''See also: [[Veris Arelius Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Veris [[Arelius family|Arelius]] is a prominent member of Arelius family{{!}}House Arelius, serving as the remaining [[Underlady]] of her lineage. She is characterized by her tall, long-limbed stature, yellow hair styled in a braid, and piercing blue eyes. Her attire consists of dark blue, black, and white clothing, which reflects the colors of her [[House]]. During combat, she has demonstrated the ability to manifest [[Storm madra|storm madra]], such as a [[Forged]] hawk, and can project large illusory images of herself. As a representative of her family, Veris is deeply invested in the legacy and survival of [[Arelius family|House Arelius]]. Following the death of the [[Tiberian Arelius|Monarch Tiberian Arelius]], which led to the loss of much of their ancestral territory on the [[Rosegold continent]], she remains focused on restoring her family's influence and ensuring their name continues to be recognized globally. She acts as a strategic figure, offering rewards and investments to potential allies to secure loyalty for [[the House]]'s future. Veris is also noted for her ability to communicate in languages similar to those used by [[Eithan|Eithan Arelius]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Veris is a woman of [[Arelius family|House Arelius]] with yellow hair styled in a braid. She possesses blue eyes.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|As the remaining [[Underlady]] of her house, she fights in honor of the late [[Tiberian Arelius]]. She communicates with others through a disembodied voice.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Veris [[Arelius family{{!}}Arelius]] is a member of the [[Arelius family]] and serves as the remaining [[Underlady]] of [[Arelius family{{!}}House Arelius]]. She fights for the late [[Tiberian Arelius]] and is the cousin of [[Eithan]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Veris is an [[Underlord]] who utilizes various lightning-based techniques in combat.}}

== Uncrowned ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|As the remaining [[Underlady]] of [[Arelius family|House Arelius]], Veris [[Arelius family|Arelius]] serves as an [[Underlord]] who fights in honor of the late [[Tiberian Arelius]]. This yellow-haired woman, characterized by her blue eyes and a single braid, utilizes lightning-based techniques in combat. She is the cousin of [[Eithan]] and often communicates with others through a disembodied voice.}}
